instruction: Open the Dota 2 Remixes EP DLC page on Steam Store.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated Steam Store, found Dota 2, browsed DLC section (Official Soundtrack at /app/1241930/ and Remixes EP at /app/652720/), added the Soundtrack to cart, and ended on the cart page.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Steam Store, search for games, find and navigate to DLC pages, add items to cart, use search bar, scroll pages
metadata.task_rationale: Tests navigation to the free DLC page (Remixes EP) that the agent also visited during the trajectory. Different target from variation 0 (Soundtrack).
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the Dota 2 Remixes EP store page. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches store.steampowered.com/app/652720 using regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify page navigation.
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly handles the rules parameter by accessing rules['expected'] directly, matching the framework's get_rule behavior for type='rule'.
Expected regex pattern 'store\.steampowered\.com/app/652720' correctly identifies the Dota 2 Remixes EP DLC page (app ID 652720 confirmed from trajectory data).
Single instruction requirement (navigate to the DLC page) is fully covered by the URL pattern check.
Data flow is correct: getter returns URL string -> metric checks string case -> regex search matches pattern against URL.
